name: peru-income-tax
description: Compute Peru individual work income tax for tax year 2026 before preparing a return, payroll reconciliation or payment. Covers domiciled individuals' fourth-category professional and director income, fifth-category employment, the 20% and 24-UIT limit, one combined 7-UIT deduction, evidenced additional expenses up to 3 UIT, progressive bands, fourth-category withholding and suspension, the actual monthly employment-withholding sequence, foreign income ordering and annual credits. Use for Impuesto a la Renta, rentas de trabajo, cuarta categoria, quinta categoria, recibos por honorarios, FV 616, FV 1609 and annual FV 709 preparation. Produces a sourced working paper and proposed filing for human approval. Capital/business computations and non-domiciled taxation require the separate category/source method.
